page.title: Device management
page.subtitle: Zero-touch provisioning over the platform VPN
page.step1: Each device leaves the factory registered for your organisation, with a claim code printed on its chassis.
page.step2: Enter the device UUID and the claim code on this page.
page.step3: Robots and gateways receive a one-time VPN key; run the command shown on the device.
page.step4: The device joins the platform VPN and appears online here.
page.step5: Sensors connect over MQTT with their factory certificate — no VPN key needed.
